digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 40
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Lumenstack ships a hardened telemetry collector build
items.summary: Lumenstack's hardened telemetry collector build runs as a non-root user and ships only the receivers and exporters most teams use. The image is signed so its provenance can be verified.

items.title: wrenfield v0.12.0 adds filtered search
items.summary: wrenfield v0.12.0 adds filtered search, so queries can restrict results by metadata, and also adds GPU-accelerated index building. Filters are evaluated during the graph walk.
items.whyItMatters: The release also drops support for Python 3.9.

items.title: Thistledown gateway adds model fallbacks
items.summary: Thistledown Gateway can fall back to a second model when the first returns an error or times out. Fallback chains are defined per route in the config.
items.whyItMatters: Each fallback attempt is logged with the reason.

sources.title: Lumenstack ships a hardened telemetry collector build
sources.summary: Lumenstack has published a hardened build of its telemetry collector. The build runs as a non-root user, ships only the receivers and exporters most teams use, and is signed so its provenance can be verified. The image is under 50 MB.

sources.title: wrenfield v0.12.0 adds filtered search
sources.summary: wrenfield v0.12.0 adds filtered search: a query can restrict results to documents whose metadata matches a filter expression. Filters are evaluated during the graph walk, not after it. The release also drops support for Python 3.9.

sources.title: Thistledown gateway adds model fallbacks
sources.summary: Thistledown Gateway can now fall back to a second model when the first returns an error or times out. Fallback chains are defined per route in the config. Each fallback attempt is logged with the reason.
